asset_boundary.future_free_policy: CC0, Public Domain, Apache-2.0 compatible, or equivalent free commercial-use audio only
asset_boundary.runtime_note: Character and enemy visuals stay on local recorded open/free sources; VFX in this file are Godot shapes, tweens, particles, and color parameters.

buses.note: default_bus_layout.tres now ships all twelve buses above, including SFXPlayer (bus/11, send SFX). The former headless exception is gone: audio_visual_validation.gd accepts player SFX nodes on SFXPlayer, so ensure_sub_buses rebuilds the full sub-bus set in every environment. BGM/SFX bus gain stays 0 dB so per-node volume_db mixes do not regress; spec_target_volumes_db still applies once per-node gains migrate onto buses (spec 20260726160400000 section 5.1/6.3).

MusicExplore.role: reserved explore-stem bus (explore loop currently rides BGM directly so the validation node-name/bus assertions hold)

MusicCombat.role: combat layer stem, faded in/out by AudioDirector.enter_combat/exit_combat (0.8 s in / 2.5 s out)

SFXPlayer.role: player voices (player_controller.gd::_sfx_bus_name); shipped in default_bus_layout.tres and rebuilt idempotently by ensure_sub_buses in all environments including headless

SFXWorld.role: main_level world SFX; ui_* keys route to the dry UI bus instead (main_level.gd::_sfx_bus_for_key)

ReverbZone.role: reverb return bus reserved for positional zones

audio_director.instantiated_by: res://scripts/main_level.gd::_build_audio (child node "AudioDirector", not an autoload; static instance set in _ready)
audio_director.static_api: request_voice (per-key rate/voice caps + 24-voice global pool, P0>P1>P2 preemption), ensure_sub_buses
audio_director.instance_api: set_chapter, enter_combat/exit_combat, start_boss_music/set_boss_phase/stop_boss_music, start_lullaby/stop_lullaby, play_stinger, duck, on_dialogue, on_key_item_pickup, on_room_changed, set_low_hp, on_player_death, set_user_volume/get_user_volume
audio_director.user_volumes: master/music/sfx/ambience sliders persisted to user://audio_settings.cfg; settings overlay on V (main_level.gd::_toggle_audio_settings)
audio_director.autoplay_guard: autoplay_enabled=false (headless validation) turns every playback path into a no-op

sfx_catalog.catalog_note: Event keys follow the naming contract in spec 20260726160500000 section 6.8. Statuses: local_audio = wired to a local recorded free asset; wired = project-synthesized CC0 asset hooked to a runtime trigger (implemented_in); asset_ready = synthesized asset on disk waiting for its mechanic (wiring_note explains); future_free_candidate = contract slot with no asset yet. Synthesized sources: tools/generate_sfx_pack.py (50 gameplay WAVs), tools/generate_ambience_pack.py (chapter beds/one-shots, chapter beats, combat completion, boss kits, UI jingles, glass/wet footsteps), tools/generate_music_pack.py (BGM, see chapter_audio_visual/global_music). All SFX playback is gated through AudioDirector.request_voice (voice caps + priority preemption).

generated_summary.format: OGG Vorbis 44.1 kHz mono (migrated from 16-bit WAV 2026-07-26 for repo size), peak-normalized, 5 ms edge fades; loops use crossfaded seams
generated_summary.runtime_loader: .ogg via AudioStreamOggVorbis through AudioDirector.load_cached (static stream cache) with legacy per-script fallback
generated_summary.superseded_note: non-kill hit confirms moved to the enemy_hit_soft/shell/armor material tiers (2026-07-26); the two WAVs stay in the enemy_actor SFX table but no code path triggers them

ambience_pack_summary.format: deterministic per-file seeded synthesis; OGG beds/one-shots/footsteps + 16-bit 44.1 kHz mono WAV beats/combat/UI; idempotent reruns
wired_events: amb_chNN_os_1..8 (48 sparse one-shots, 45-120 s at -6 dB)
asset_ready_events: chNN_<slug>_beat_01..03_audio (15 chapter beats, ch02-ch06; see chapter_audio_visual)
